sql: SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE type = 'Checking' AND balance < (SELECT MIN(balance) FROM accounts WHERE type = 'Checking')
SELECT client_id FROM clients WHERE branch = (SELECT branch FROM clients WHERE name = 'ABC')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE balance < 0
SELECT * FROM clients WHERE branch = (SELECT branch FROM clients WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM clients))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE tx_date = (SELECT MAX(tx_date) FROM transactions WHERE account_id IN (SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE type = 'Checking'))
WITH client_data AS (SELECT id, name, branch FROM clients)
WITH account_balance AS (SELECT account_id, SUM(balance) AS total_balance FROM accounts GROUP BY account_id)
WITH transaction_amount AS (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM transactions GROUP BY account_id)
WITH client_branch AS (SELECT id, name, branch FROM clients)
WITH account_type AS (SELECT client_id, COUNT(*) AS num_transactions FROM transactions GROUP BY client_id)
SELECT name, AVG(fee) FROM appointments GROUP BY name HAVING AVG(fee) > 1000
SELECT doctors.name, AVG(appointments.fee) FROM doctors JOIN appointments ON doctors.id = appointments.doctor_id GROUP BY doctors.name
SELECT name, COUNT(*) FROM appointments GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
SELECT doctors.specialty, AVG(appointments.fee) FROM doctors JOIN appointments ON doctors.id = appointments.doctor_id GROUP BY doctors.specialty
SELECT patients.name, AVG(appointments.fee) FROM patients JOIN appointments ON patients.id = appointments.patient_id GROUP BY patients.name
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY quantity * price DESC) AS row_num, name, price, category, quantity FROM orders;

SELECT patients.id, appointments.appt_date, patients.name AS patient_name, doctors.name AS doctor_name, appointments.fee FROM patients INNER JOIN appointments ON patients.id = appointments.patient_id INNER JOIN doctors ON appointments.doctor_id = doctors.id WHERE appointments.appt_date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31'.
WITH TotalRevenue AS (SELECT SUM(price_per_night * nights) FROM bookings)
WITH AvailableRooms AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rooms WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT room_id FROM bookings))
WITH UpcomingBookings AS (SELECT check_in FROM bookings WHERE nights > 0)
WITH BookedRooms AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings WHERE room_id IN (SELECT id FROM rooms))
WITH RoomRevenue AS (SELECT SUM(price_per_night * nights) FROM bookings WHERE room_id IN (SELECT id FROM rooms))
WITH customer_names AS (SELECT name FROM customers)
WITH product_details AS (SELECT name, price FROM products)
WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers))
WITH product_total AS (SELECT SUM(quantity * price) FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id)
WITH customer_top_product AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(quantity) as max_quantity FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id)
WITH CTE AS (SELECT account_id FROM accounts UNION SELECT account_id FROM transactions)
SELECT count(*) FROM CTE
WITH CTE AS (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) FROM transactions GROUP BY account_id UNION SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) FROM accounts GROUP BY account_id)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE balance < 0 UNION SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE amount < 0
WITH CTE AS (SELECT client_id FROM clients WHERE branch = 'New York' UNION SELECT client_id FROM clients WHERE branch = 'Los Angeles')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM CTE)
SELECT * FROM loans WHERE book_id IS NULL
SELECT * FROM loans WHERE member_id IS NULL
SELECT * FROM books WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT book_id FROM loans)
SELECT b.title, m.name, COALESCE(l.loan_date, 'Never') FROM books b LEFT JOIN loans l ON b.id = l.book_id LEFT JOIN members m ON l.member_id = m.id WHERE b.year < (SELECT MAX(year) FROM loans)
SELECT * FROM customers WHERE id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE quantity > 1)
SELECT * FROM products WHERE price IN (SELECT price FROM orders WHERE quantity > 1)
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE name = 'John')
SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM orders WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE city = 'New York')
SELECT * FROM customers WHERE category IN (SELECT category FROM products WHERE price IN (SELECT price FROM orders))
SELECT * FROM loans WHERE book_id IS NULL;
SELECT loans.loan_date FROM loans LEFT JOIN loans2 ON loans.id = loans2.id WHERE loans2.loan_date IS NULL;
WITH booked_rooms AS (SELECT room_id, price_per_night FROM bookings)
WITH booked_rooms AS (SELECT room_id, price_per_night FROM bookings WHERE nights > 1),
WITH booked_rooms AS (SELECT room_id, SUM(nights) AS total_nights FROM bookings GROUP BY room_id),
WITH booked_rooms AS (SELECT guest_id, COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM bookings GROUP BY guest_id),
WITH booked_rooms AS (SELECT room_id, AVG(price_per_night) AS average_price FROM bookings GROUP BY room_id)
SELECT name FROM students GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) > 2;
SELECT * FROM loans WHERE loan_date IS NULL;
SELECT loans.loan_date FROM loans LEFT JOIN loans ON loans.id = loans2.id WHERE loans2.loan_date IS NULL AND loans.loan_date IS NOT NULL;
SELECT * FROM loans WHERE loan_date = (SELECT MAX(loan_date) FROM loans WHERE loan_date IS NOT NULL);
WITH borrowed_books AS (SELECT book_id FROM loans WHERE returned = 0),
SELECT book_id FROM borrowed_books;
WITH loan_summary AS (SELECT AVG(returned) AS avg_returned FROM loans),
SELECT loan_date, SUM(returned) FROM loans GROUP BY loan_date ORDER BY SUM(returned) DESC;
WITH members_with_loans AS (SELECT m.name, COUNT(l.id) FROM members m JOIN loans l ON m.id = l.member_id GROUP BY m.id),
SELECT name, COUNT(*) FROM members_with_loans WHERE id IN (SELECT member_id FROM loans WHERE returned = 0);
WITH books_without_loans AS (SELECT title FROM books WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT book_id FROM loans)),
SELECT * FROM books_without_loans;
SELECT RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY book_id ORDER BY year DESC) AS book_year_rank, * FROM loans
SELECT title, author, loan_date, CASE WHEN returned = 1 THEN 'Returned' ELSE 'Not returned' END FROM loans
SELECT name, CASE WHEN year - joined > 1 THEN 'New' ELSE 'Returning' END FROM members
SELECT name, AVG(fee) FROM appointments GROUP BY name HAVING AVG(fee) > 100
SELECT name, COUNT(*) FROM appointments GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
SELECT specialty, AVG(fee) FROM appointments GROUP BY specialty HAVING AVG(fee) > 50
SELECT title, AVG(grade) FROM courses GROUP BY title HAVING AVG(grade) > 3.5;
SELECT students.name FROM enrollments JOIN courses ON enrollments.course_id = courses.id;
SELECT * FROM courses JOIN enrollments ON courses.id = enrollments.course_id GROUP BY courses.id;
